A compromise petition under Section 320 of Cr.P.C, duly signed by both petitioners and respondent No.2 and their respective counsel is filed.

5. The terms and conditions of settlement arrived at between the parties reads as under:
2.

It is submitted that, at the instance of well wishers, family friends and relatives the dispute between the petitioners and respondent No.2 have been amicable resolved and both the parties had NC: 2025:KHC:35363 HC-KAR filed this application by settling the dispute among themselves as per the following terms and conditions:
a.

The 2nd respondent who is wife of 1st petitioner herein whose marriage was held on 19.09.2018 had agreed and undertaken that she would withdraw the entire allegations made against the petitioners and also withdraw the complaint lodged by her before the 1st respondent.

b. The 2nd respondent had also agreed that she would not pursue or prosecute the proceedings initiated against the petitioners in CC No. 17346/2020 before the 8th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru pursuant to the complaint lodged by her against the petitioners in future.

entities.text: 8th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: C. Further, 2nd respondent has also agreed and undertaken she would not make any nature of allegations against the petitioner or any other family members of the petitioners in future.

d. Both 1st petitioner and 2nd respondent in terms of the settlement arrived between both the family members had agreed and undertaken that they would initiate appropriate proceedings before the competent Court for dissolution of their marriage held on 19.09.2018.
e.

The 2nd respondent has also agreed and undertaken that she is not interested to lead a family NC: 2025:KHC:35363 HC-KAR life with the 1st petitioner and hence,
2nd respondent has agreed that she would file a petition for divorce along with the 1st petitioner and obtain a mutual divorce by dissolving their marriage and also agreed that the said proceedings shall be initiated with a period of 15 days from the date of acceptance of this compromise petition.
f. Both the parties have agreed that there is no claims against each in any nature or any manner against each other in future.
The 2nd respondent has also agreed that she would voluntarily appear before the competent court for obtaining mutual divorce and would not make any nature of claim against the petitioners in future.
